description: This file defines the QrService class which manages QR code login sessions, including creation, retrieval, authentication challenge generation, and verification workflows within a user authentication backend.

classes.name: QrService
classes.description: Service class handling QR session lifecycle, authentication challenge management, and token generation for the QR code login process.

methods.name: randomToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random 16-byte hexadecimal token.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and stores a new QR login session with a specified TTL.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves a QR session by its UUID.

methods.name: getAuthOptionsForSession
methods.description: Associates an authentication challenge with a session and returns the request options for WebAuthn.

methods.name: verifyForSession
methods.description: Verifies authentication response, updates session status, and issues a JWT token.
